413-2738-3220-4871.description:

Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Tenacious Dead enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.

Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

628-5007-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.
628-5007-6798.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

Resolve the trigger from step 2, returning your commander from the command zone to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
